stations.title: Lior
stations.say: The late show text is dark on dark.

stations.title: Late show box
stations.text: A light --ink, set on a dark box.

captions: At the Wrenfield, Lior finds the new late show box hard to read on a phone.
The box sets a light ink, but its paragraph and list stay dark on the dark background.
You trace where the writing gets its colour and fix it in the box and in the footer.
Now the late show box is light writing on dark, and so is the footer.
Same colours, worked out in the right place. Everything else on the page is unchanged.
